requestedIntent: Opt-in Standard + Guarded runs may PASS only after an independent reviewer exercised the running product with hash-bound browser evidence bound to the current scoped application tree.
limitations: Opt-in Standard + Guarded only; no global hook interception or automatic executor added.
Synthetic regression fixtures establish validator behavior, not product quality.
Hashed local evidence and actor identity bind recorded review but cannot independently prove a browser visit or the honesty of an observation.
Any loopback origin passes unless the run, the active run or the host-owned .acef/product-review-policy.json pins one.
The tenancy check is mandatory; a host without tenants or accounts records how isolation was exercised or does not opt in.
objective-control-budget authority file/hash binds a recorded decision, not proof of human authorization.

evidence.note: Synthetic regression: independence, tree freshness incl. globstar, browser artifacts, origin pinning, reuse audit, lifecycle integration.

provenance: Ported 2026-10-27 from a host fork (commits 6dcda63, d97a3ec, e006745, 5aaf9d7, 200259d) into upstream; neutral origin handling added.
